verdict.rationale: Pipedream's homepage claims users can "Prompt, run, edit, and deploy AI agents in seconds," which suggests natural-language prompting to build agents. The error docs say you can "debug these errors with AI," a narrow natural-language assist. The MCP server and CLI let agents call third-party APIs or let users run explicit commands, not operate Pipedream itself through natural language. Missing for 10: documented natural-language workflow creation and editing, NL control of the product beyond agent prompting and error debugging, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
